hero.title: Super App for Everything You Need
hero.subtitle: One integrated ecosystem for ride, food, send, and wallet — fast, secure, and effortless to use.

features.title: Four Services, One Ecosystem
features.subtitle: Designed as a modular monolith with a unified API, every feature runs fast and reliably.

ride.title: G-Ride
ride.desc: Book a ride in seconds with real-time driver dispatch and reliable cancellation handling.

food.title: G-Food
food.desc: Order from your favorite merchants with secure 4-way settlement between customers, merchants, and drivers.

send.title: G-Send
send.desc: Send packages instantly with multi-stop routes, real-time driver tracking, and 3-way payment splits.

wallet.title: PayPulse
wallet.desc: Digital wallet with double-entry ledger, instant top-up, transfers, and JWT + RBAC security.

tech.title: Built on Modern Technology
tech.subtitle: A robust, scalable stack from backend to mobile apps.

go.name: Go

flutter.name: Flutter
